I'm Ivan, a biotechnology professional and MS/MBA graduate student at [The Johns Hopkins University](https://www.jhu.edu/), where I also serve as a [Center for Innovative Leadership Fellow](https://cil.carey.jhu.edu/). By training I'm a molecular biologist, but over the past 10+ years I've worn many hats in the diagnostics industry as an assay developer, polymer chemist, data scientist, and technical product leader.

My career journey has taken me from R&D bench work developing novel polymer chemistry for liquid biopsy analysis at Monolythix, to leading cross-functional teams through FDA regulatory pathways at companies like BiologyWorks and [Detect](https://www.detect.com). Along the way, I've helped develop molecular diagnostic platforms achieving [99.1% accuracy](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220116005038/en/BiologyWorks-know-COVID-19-Clinical-Trial-Matches-99.1-Accuracy-to-RT-PCR-Tests), contributed to securing funding for COVID-19 testing solutions, and earned two [patents](https://patents.google.com/?inventor=Ivan+RUEDA) in diagnostic technologies. 

What drives me is advancing healthcare journeys for individuals by making complex diagnostics approachable and finding the hidden connections that translate breakthrough science into accessible, actionable solutions. Through my graduate studies, I'm exploring how healthcare economics, leadership, and regulatory affairs intersect to advance innovative healthcare technologies to market, which directly informs my vision for democratizing precision diagnostics.

I currently live in Chicago with my girlfriend and our corgi. In my free time, I like to play my guitar or synthesizer.
